_comment: Catalog shown by the manager's 'Browse Mods' page.
Fetched on open and cached locally, so adding a mod here reaches every user without
shipping a new build of the app.
This is only a list of pointers. Anything installed from here goes through the ordinary
installer - same type detection, same placement rules, same conflict checking - so being
listed grants a mod no special treatment.
Per mod:
id        required. Stable identifier. Keep it fixed even if the name changes.
name      required. Shown as the heading.
repo      required. GitHub repository holding the releases. github.com only.
summary   one line shown under the name.
type      LogicMod | PatchMod | LuaMod. Display only - the installer decides the real
type by reading the files, so a wrong value here misleads nobody but the reader.
version   current version, shown next to the name.
asset     which release file to download, if a release carries more than one. Without
it the manager only proceeds when there's exactly one installable archive.
requires  other catalog ids this mod needs. Shown to the user, never auto-installed.
tags      free-text labels, searchable from the page.
Entries without a name or a valid GitHub repo are dropped when the file is read, so a
half-written entry shortens the list rather than breaking the page.
